titlePre: Land Rover Defender D300 ENGINE REBUILD

steps.title: Diagnosis
steps.body: We confirm your exact engine code and assess the damage.

steps.title: Removal
steps.body: Your engine is removed and brought into our workshop.

steps.title: Strip-Down
steps.body: Every component is removed for individual inspection.

steps.title: Inspection
steps.body: Crankshaft, cylinder head, timing chain, bearings, water pump and gaskets are all checked.

steps.title: Machine Work
steps.body: Any machining required is carried out to OEM tolerances.

steps.title: Component Replacement
steps.body: Worn or damaged parts are replaced with updated OEM components.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: Your engine is rebuilt to original specification.

steps.title: Testing
steps.body: Every rebuild is pressure-tested before refit.

steps.title: Refit
steps.body: Your engine goes back into your Defender D300.

steps.title: Road Test
steps.body: A full road test confirms everything's right before we hand your car back.
